extracted.intended_audience: journalists, media professionals, and the general public seeking Brookhaven Lab news or media contacts
extracted.subtask_description: The main newsroom/index page for Brookhaven National Laboratory that aggregates news releases, feature stories, media contacts, photos/videos, and links to policies and resources for press/communications.

rubrics_metrics.name: Newsclips posting policy
rubrics_metrics.description: Newsclips are articles in the press that are either about Brookhaven or are of interest to the Brookhaven community. Posting of these articles does not imply an endorsement of their content.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Clarifies that the Lab collects and posts third-party press items of relevance but does not endorse the content — important when reusing/attributing external news items.

rubrics_metrics.name: Social media policy (referenced)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The page references a social media policy for the Lab; consult that policy for guidance on posting, sharing, and engaging on social platforms related to Lab content.
